% Synthetic fixture: the companion branch of math-face resolution. No
% \fonts math key — the body family's designed companion (Fira Sans →
% Fira Math, both shipped beside this file) serves the formulas, scaled so
% the two x-heights agree, and the build names the pick once (N0016).
\documentclass{article}
\fonts{ dir = "fonts", body = "Fira Sans" }

\begin{document}

\section{An Undeclared Math Face}

The map $f(x) = x^2 - 1$ sits inline beside its sentence, its x at the
sentence's own optical size. A display formula takes the same face:

\[ \sum_{k=1}^{n} k = \frac{n(n+1)}{2} \]

The paragraph continues after the display, still in the body face.

\end{document}
